Headline: No trains between 54th/Cermak and Pulaski
ShortDescription: Pink Line service has been temporarily suspended between 54th/Cermak and Pulaski due to an obstruction.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Pink Line service has been temporarily suspended between 54th/Cermak and Pulaski due to an obstruction.

As a result, trains are operating only between The Loop and Central Park at this time.

Shuttle buses have been requested between 54th/Cermak and Central Park in both directions provide connecting service through the affected area.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:
#21 Cermak
#82 Kimball-Homan

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
